segments.text: This is your complete Chapter seven toolkit, gathered in one place. We restate each result, without re-teaching it — think final-revision, not first-learning.

First, Newton's law and the constant: force is big G m one m two over r squared, and big G is six point six seven times ten to the minus eleven, with dimensions M to the minus one, L cubed, T to the minus two.

Field intensity: outside any sphere it is big G M over r squared; inside a shell it is zero; inside a solid sphere it grows as big G M r over R cubed; and on a ring's axis it is big G M x over the three-halves power of a squared plus x squared.

Acceleration due to gravity: at the surface big G M over R squared, equal to four thirds pi big G R rho; with altitude, about g times one minus two h over R; with depth, g times one minus d over R; and with rotation, g minus omega squared R cos squared lambda.

Potential and energy: potential energy minus big G M m over r; potential minus big G M over r; field the negative slope of potential; and escape velocity root two big G M over R, which is root two g R.

Kepler and satellites: orbital velocity root big G M over r; period two pi root r cubed over big G M; total energy minus big G M m over two r, with kinetic equal to minus E and potential equal to two E.

The constant and two-body systems: the Earth's mass g R squared over big G; density three g over four pi big G R; a binary's angular velocity from the total mass; and the reduced mass m one m two over the total.

And the golden links: escape velocity is root two times orbital velocity; the near-surface period is two pi root R over g, about eighty-four minutes; and you can weigh anything by its orbit, four pi squared r cubed over big G T squared.
<whisper>Revise from this sheet, but do not re-derive. Every single result here is one you have already proved earlier in the chapter.
यह आपका पूरा Chapter seven toolkit है, एक जगह इकट्ठा। हम हर result को दोहराते हैं, बिना दोबारा पढ़ाए — final-revision समझिए, first-learning नहीं।

पहले, Newton का law और constant: force है big G m one m two over r squared, और big G है six point six seven into ten to the minus eleven, dimensions M to the minus one, L cubed, T to the minus two के साथ।

Field intensity: किसी भी sphere के बाहर यह big G M over r squared है; एक shell के अंदर zero; एक solid sphere के अंदर यह big G M r over R cubed के हिसाब से बढ़ता है; और एक ring के axis पर यह big G M x over a squared plus x squared की three-halves power है।

Acceleration due to gravity: surface पर big G M over R squared, बराबर four thirds pi big G R rho; altitude के साथ, लगभग g into one minus two h over R; depth के साथ, g into one minus d over R; और rotation के साथ, g minus omega squared R cos squared lambda।
Potential और energy: potential energy minus big G M m over r; potential minus big G M over r; field, potential का negative slope; और escape velocity root two big G M over R, यानी root two g R।
Kepler और satellites: orbital velocity root big G M over r; period two pi root r cubed over big G M; total energy minus big G M m over two r, kinetic बराबर minus E और potential बराबर two E के साथ।
Constant और two-body systems: Earth का mass g R squared over big G; density three g over four pi big G R; एक binary की angular velocity total mass से; और reduced mass m one m two over total।

और सुनहरे links: escape velocity, orbital velocity की root two गुना है; near-surface period है two pi root R over g, लगभग चौरासी मिनट; और आप किसी भी चीज़ को उसकी orbit से तौल सकते हैं, four pi squared r cubed over big G T squared।
<whisper>इस sheet से revise कीजिए, पर दोबारा derive मत कीजिए। यहाँ का हर एक result वही है जो आप chapter में पहले साबित कर चुके हैं।

sections.title: Chapter 7 quick-recall cheat sheet

board_events.text: Chapter 7 — quick recall
Newton: $F=Gm_1m_2/r^2$; attractive, central; valid for points, spheres, sphere+point.
Field: outside = point mass; shell inside = 0; solid $\propto r$; ring peaks at $a/\sqrt{2}$.
g: max at the surface; height has the 2, depth does not; poles heavier.
Energy: $U,V$ negative; zero field ≠ zero potential; $v_e=\sqrt{2}\,v_o$.
Satellites: $T\propto r^{3/2}$; $E=-GMm/2r$ (negative); weightless = free fall.
Constant & binary: orbits give $GM$, Cavendish gives $G$; heavier star, smaller circle.
Magic numbers: $v_o\approx7.9$, $v_e\approx11.2$ km/s, $T\approx84$ min, geo $\approx36000$ km.

segments.text: Finally, the whole chapter in a single quick-recall sweep — the one-liners to run through the night before the exam.
Newton's law: force is big G m one m two over r squared; always attractive and central; and it applies directly only to point masses, uniform spheres, or a sphere and a point.
Field intensity: outside any sphere it acts like a point mass; inside a shell it is zero; inside a solid sphere it rises linearly with r; and on a ring's axis it peaks at a over root two.
Acceleration due to gravity: it is greatest at the surface; height carries the factor of two while depth does not; and the poles feel heavier from both the smaller radius and the missing spin.
Potential and energy: both U and V are negative; zero field does not mean zero potential; and escape velocity is root two times orbital velocity.
Satellites: the period goes as r to the three halves; the total energy is minus big G M m over two r, which is negative; and weightlessness is shared free fall, not absent gravity.
The constant and binaries: orbits give only the product big G M, while Cavendish gives big G itself; and in a binary the heavier star orbits the smaller circle.

<excited>And the magic numbers that crack half the questions on sight: orbital speed about seven point nine, escape about eleven point two kilometres per second, the eighty-four-minute period, and geostationary at about thirty-six thousand kilometres. That is all of Gravitation, in your pocket.
आख़िर में, पूरा chapter एक quick-recall झलक में — exam से पहली रात दोहराने वाले one-liners।
Newton का law: force है big G m one m two over r squared; हमेशा attractive और central; और यह सीधे सिर्फ़ point masses, uniform spheres, या एक sphere और एक point पर लागू होता है।

Field intensity: किसी भी sphere के बाहर यह एक point mass की तरह act करता है; एक shell के अंदर zero; एक solid sphere के अंदर यह r के साथ linearly बढ़ता है; और एक ring के axis पर यह a over root two पर peak करता है।
Acceleration due to gravity: यह surface पर सबसे ज़्यादा है; height में two का factor है जबकि depth में नहीं; और poles छोटे radius और ग़ायब spin दोनों से भारी लगते हैं।
Potential और energy: U और V दोनों negative हैं; zero field का मतलब zero potential नहीं; और escape velocity, orbital velocity की root two गुना है।
Satellites: period, r to the three halves के हिसाब से चलता है; total energy है minus big G M m over two r, जो negative है; और weightlessness shared free fall है, ग़ैर-मौजूद gravity नहीं।
Constant और binaries: orbits सिर्फ़ product big G M देती हैं, जबकि Cavendish big G ख़ुद देता है; और एक binary में भारी star छोटे circle पर orbit करता है।

<excited>और वो magic numbers जो देखते ही आधे सवाल crack कर देते हैं: orbital speed लगभग seven point nine, escape लगभग eleven point two kilometres per second, चौरासी-मिनट का period, और geostationary लगभग छत्तीस हज़ार kilometres। यही पूरा Gravitation है, आपकी जेब में।
